items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The whole thing, tuba was your bass; you know you had the tuba, you had the two pianos, you had like… it was a whole different feel.

ctx.x: I didn’t realize until later on that he was a marvelous replica of a mid-20s dance band. That had never changed his style and to me it just sounded corny and weird and out of tune and everything but hearing it now, it wasn’t atypical of what went on in the 20s at all.
The whole thing, tuba was your bass; you know you had the tuba, you had the two pianos, you had like… it was a whole different feel. Banjo on the off beats and then later guitar.
